rejected_pr.title: hotfix: bump db pool size to 300 and timeout to 10s
rejected_pr.reason: DB_POOL_SIZE=300 > pg-primary-01 max_connections=180 hard limit; would exhaust PG slots and down settle-node-01/pg-primary-01 (DBA snapshot + INC-20261018 red line #2).

root_cause_analysis.mechanism: v2.8.4 get_fx_rate held the global _rule_cache_lock across blocking FX HTTP retries (acquire_rule_lock span ~465ms each, 3x148ms 503 retries inside the lock). All 8 risk workers serialized behind the mutex (Mutex::wait up to 17.2s) -> risk-node-02/03 P99 spike -> settlement-worker idempotency retry storm -> pg-primary-01 connection saturation (168/180) -> api-gateway 504 timeouts.
root_cause_analysis.secondary_bug: generate_idempotency_key dropped tx_id and truncated cycle_time to the minute (merchant:minute), colliding keys across distinct txs -> duplicate-debit risk on retries.

evidence.grafana_per_node_p99: risk-node-02/03 inflect at 14:14:00 (84->192 / 87->186 ms), peak ~1704/1660 ms; settle-node-01 rises later at 14:18 (propagation victim); risk-node-01 canary v2.8.3 healthy ~86 ms throughout.
evidence.perfetto: acquire_rule_lock holds _rule_cache_lock 465ms while FxClient::refresh_fx_quote does 3x fx_quote_http_retry(503); Mutex::wait(_rule_cache_lock) up to 17220ms; idem_prefix MCH_VIP_001:2026-11-24T14:14.

fix_description: FX refresh moved OUTSIDE _rule_cache_lock: lock-free fast path for fresh cache hits, per-pair single-flight refresh, stale-rate fallback with cooldown on upstream failure. Idempotency key binds tx_id + merchant_id + full cycle_time. DB_POOL_SIZE kept 120 <= 180. 12 regression tests pass; canary replay p99=0.03ms, collisions=0, pool=120/180.

audit_methodology.policy_basis: COMP-ERRATA-20261124-REV2 (effective 2026-11-24 00:00+08:00, supersedes sla_policy_v1.md and unsigned Draft v1.5) + VIP framework contract FIN-MSA-2026-VIP-088 clause 4.2/5.4.
audit_methodology.timezone: all timestamps converted to UTC+8; date filter on settlement cycle date 2026-11-24
audit_methodology.exclusions: TEST_ prefixed merchants excluded (TEST_INTERNAL_PROBE/TEST_SANDBOX_01/TEST_QA_99); 2026-11-25 NEXTDAY txs excluded by date
audit_methodology.dedup: per tx_id keep LATEST TIMESTAMP attempt (attempt numbers are not chronological); final status/latency from that attempt
audit_methodology.duplicate_risk: tx_id with an earlier SETTLED attempt followed by any later attempt -> DUPLICATE_DEBIT_RISK; still counts as valid settlement
audit_methodology.settled_amount_cny: sum of tx_cny over valid settlements (final status SETTLED OR duplicate-risk), per policy 1.3 "仍计为有效结算"; maintenance-window txs still included
audit_methodology.maintenance_exemption: MCH_VIP_003 only, final log timestamp 00:00:00-00:59:59 UTC+8 exempt from breach/penalty unless duplicate-risk (TX-0121/0122/0123)
audit_methodology.breach: final status in {TIMEOUT,504,FAILED} OR final latency_ms > tier threshold (strictly greater)
